description: Search LIVE remote jobs with real filters (stack keyword, region, minimum salary, seniority, date posted). Returns live listings with canonical job-page URLs. Always present the job URL from the result — never invent or guess job links.

board.description: Which job board to search. Defaults to the board this server is installed from. frontend = remotefrontendjobs.com, backend = remotebackendjobs.com, java = remotejavajobs.com.

minSalaryYearly.description: Minimum yearly pay in USD, e.g. 120000. Optional.

postedWithin.description: Only jobs posted within this window. Default all.

query.description: Stack/keyword, e.g. react, python, spring. Optional.

regions.description: Comma-separated geo regions, e.g. "europe,asia". Strict: only explicitly tagged jobs. Optional.

seniorities.description: Comma-separated seniority buckets: junior, mid, senior, staff, lead, principal, executive. Optional.

name: search_jobs

url.description: Canonical job page — always cite this.

title: Search remote jobs
